observed.facings.png: Three facings at one scale. South and north are small, upright, standing birds about 85 px tall. East is a very long horizontal profile: a blue bird with a thick black outline and flat cel colour. Its wing hangs down below the body, its head has a curled crest, and its tail is a very long streamer with gold edging trailing far to the left. Beside east, south and north look like a much smaller animal by body mass, although their heights match.
observed.south.png: Front view of a standing bird facing the camera. It has a dark slate head with a pale, pointed, slightly hooked beak and a yellow-gold throat and breast stripe. Its slate-blue wings are folded around the body with pale edging. It has grey scaly legs and clawed feet, and the tail rises above and behind the head as a narrow gold-edged plume. Shading is soft and painterly, with no black outline. The background is clean alpha.
observed.east.png: Installed east profile, which is accepted art. Flat cel-shaded blue bird with heavy black keylines. It has an S-curved neck, a pale throat, a dark curled crest at the back of the head, and a wing that droops and is half-lowered below the body. A very long tail with gold edging and scale-like markings trails horizontally. Clean alpha.
observed.north.png: Rear view of a standing bird. A small dark head with a crest is seen from behind at the top. No eyes or beak face the camera, though a pale lighter strip runs down one side of the head. Slate-blue folded wings with pale edges cover the back. Grey legs and feet show at the bottom. A long tail with gold edging trails down toward the camera, foreshortened, ending in a forked tip. Painterly, no outline, clean alpha.
observed.scale.png: Only the east sprite is shown beside the human and a rat. At max zoom the east bird spans about 3.3 cells, mostly tail, and the body is about human-head-to-torso size. At 32 px/cell the blue body and long tail still read. South and north are not shown in this panel.

reply.image_seen: The composite shows blue-and-gold front, side and rear birds; the individual images show a frontal hooked beak, an outlined long-tailed east profile, and a narrow rear with trailing tail; the scale panel places the east profile beside a human and rat.

concerns.evidence: East has a thick black contour and broad, sharply separated blue shading regions. South and north have soft grey edges and fine shaded feather texture. The difference is immediately visible in the shared-scale composite. Folded versus lowered wings alone would be acceptable, but the rendering changes conspicuously between facings.

East's large silhouette includes its horizontally extended tail and downward-projecting wing. South and north show the torso end-on with wings held closer to the sides; their narrower silhouettes follow those visible pose and perspective differences. The measured height spread is 0%, and these images do not establish a separate body-scale mismatch.

request.prompt: Draw the SAME individual animal as the attached reference image (its accepted east side view): same anatomy, same proportions, same blue-and-gold colours and markings, same size on the canvas, seen from the view this job asks for. A creature sprite for RimWorld: the Peko-peko, a large colourful reptavian native to the swamps of Naboo, with scaly reptile skin, a strong heavy beak with a downward hook at the tip, and a dark charcoal crest sweeping back from the rear of the skull. Copy the reference's rendering exactly so this view and the east view read as one sprite set: flat cel-style colour shapes with sharply bounded edges, two or three flat tones per colour area, a few large crisp scale-pattern marks, and the same heavy, uniform dark outline around the whole silhouette and around the beak, wings, legs and feet. Hold the wings as the reference does: each wing hangs half-lowered and drooping from the shoulder, feather tips pointing down and slightly outward, drawn as bold outlined shapes. The front view (eyes toward the viewer) shows the head facing the camera, the beak closed or only slightly parted so the heavy hooked beak reads clearly, the dark crest framing the top and sides of the head, the pale blue and gold on the chest, the half-lowered wings at both sides of the body, and the legs and feet below. The rear view (seen from behind) shows the back, the half-lowered wings, the tail and the haunches, with the dark crest at the back of the skull and the eyes hidden. Exactly ONE creature, centred, the whole body visible with nothing cut off. Vanilla RimWorld sprite style with the reference's bold outline and flat cel shading. Fully transparent background: no ground, no water, no shadow, no text, no border.

subject: RM_Lirrith

observed.facings.png: Three facings at one shared scale, all the same height. South: a lean, dark-brown, four-legged creature facing the camera. A pale olive-green ridged crest runs from the brow down a narrow hooked snout, with four small yellow glowing eyes on either side of it. It has thin clawed legs, ridged ribs on the chest, and a tail rising behind it and curling into a hook above its head. East: a full side profile. The body is gaunt with clearly visible ribs under tight dark skin. It has long thin legs with clawed feet and a long tail sweeping up and curling forward over the rump into a hook. The head is beaked and downturned, with a fluted pale-green crest of several ridges running up the snout and four yellow eyes in a row below it. North: the rear, with the haunches, ribbed flanks and the back of the four legs. The tail rises from the rump and curls into a hook at the top. Only the tip of the green crest shows over the shoulders. No eyes or face are visible.
observed.south.png: Full-resolution south view on alpha. It shows the front: crest down the centre of the snout, four yellow eyes (two per side), a hooked beak tip, thin forelegs with splayed claws, and the hind legs behind. The curled tail shows above the back. No ground or shadow.
observed.east.png: Full-resolution east profile on alpha. The gaunt ribbed body, the long curled hooked tail, a crest of about six pale-green ridges up the snout, four yellow eyes in a row and the downcurved beak are all clear. It has a walking stance on four thin legs. No backdrop.
observed.north.png: Full-resolution north view on alpha. It shows the rear with haunches, ribbed flanks and the curled tail rising over the back. A sliver of crest shows above the shoulders. No eyes and no face. The body is narrower than on south but has the same anatomy.
observed.scale.png: At max zoom, beside the vanilla human, the creature is roughly as long as the human is tall and stands about two-thirds of the human's height. At 32 px/cell (normal play) it reads as a thin dark quadruped with a curled tail. The pale crest is a faint light spot.

SOUTH_FRONT.seen: South shows the head facing the camera, with the crest down the centre of the snout and four yellow eyes.

NORTH_REAR.seen: North shows the haunches, the back of the legs and the curled tail. Only the crest tip shows over the shoulders, with no eyes or face.

NO_OVERHEAD.seen: All three facings are drawn from the angled game camera with the legs standing on the ground. None is a top-down plan.

SAME_SIZE.seen: The measured height spread is 0%. The facings look matched in facings.png.

SAME_ANIMAL.seen: The same dark ribbed body, thin clawed legs, curled hooked tail and green crest appear on all three facings. The tail curls up over the back in every view, and the crest turns with the head (centred on south, lengthwise on east, hidden behind the shoulders on north).

SIGNATURE.seen: The fluted pale-green crest up the snout and the four glowing yellow eyes are clear on south and east.

ALIEN.seen: The beaked hooked snout, ridged crest, four eyes, scorpion-like curled tail and skeletal ribs mean a stranger would not name it as a hyena or dog at first glance.

DEPARTURES.seen: 1) Four glowing yellow eyes: present on south and east. 2) Fluted pale-green crest up the snout: present, prominent on east. 3) Long hooked tail curled over the back: present on all facings. 4) Dark tight skin over visible ribs: present, with the ribs strongly drawn on east and also showing on south and north.

STYLE.seen: Painterly shading with a thin dark outline and realistic gaunt anatomy. Not cute or cel-shaded, and not a photo or 3D render.

OURS.seen: It is a bespoke invented creature that matches the description, not any vanilla or other-mod animal.

ALPHA.seen: Clean cut-out on the checkerboard with no ground patch, shadow or halo.

SCALE.seen: Beside the human it is about two-thirds of the human's height and about human length. The description says 'small', so it reads somewhat large for a small scavenger, but this is a plausible pack-hunter size. Possible polish only.

LEGIBLE.seen: At 32 px it reads as a thin dark quadruped with a distinctive curled tail. The crest is a faint pale accent and the thin legs are faint against the ground.
